subject: Differences between local and remote execution

messages.author: a2c316298c1ee632
messages.subject: Differences between local and remote execution
parts:
So, I had a project with 5 rCharts graphs in it. It ran fine on my laptop, but I ran into problems when I deployed it to an AWS server. Specifically, two things tripped me up. Special characters in the id field... for example: htmlOutput("first_graph"). Once I removed the underscore, it worked. 

The other problem I had was with UTF-8 characters... specifically the degree symbol: °. I had this in the y-axis of a couple of the graphs. Once I removed it, everything worked. 

Has anybody encountered things like this? A big problem with my experience here using rCharts / highcharts is that these problems did not trigger an error or warning, they failed silently and no graphs would appear on the page. 

Thanks

messages.author: 85e053d519f0f372
messages.subject: Re: Differences between local and remote execution
parts:
The underscore problem seems odd. It is not a special character in
JavaScript or jQuery, so I have no idea why it would fail.

For the UTF-8 character, we have seen many cases of failure and the
common reason is that the AWS server environment may be using a C
locale instead of UTF-8. You can check locale in the terminal or
sessionInfo() in R on the server to see what the locale is. If it is
not UTF-8, you may need to set it to C.UTF-8 or en_US.UTF-8 if you
have the language package installed.

Regards,
Yihui
